interpretation_rules: Manuscript archival file numbers are storage identifiers only; do not infer order, revision, or substantive dependence from their suffixes.
Script filename numbers are likewise not proof of manuscript ownership, execution order, or model consistency.
Where a source file itself documents reliance on another dataset or code version, record that as source-reported only, then verify import, invocation or input provenance.
Geometry and numerical equivalence must be validated from mathematical definitions, inputs, actual integer vertex/edge/operator arrays, and output hashes.
The reported finite PF-I6 matched central window checks are about their recorded functions and inputs, independent of any paper-name order.
Any printed in-text references such as Paper N are historical text and must not substitute for source-content identity.
